component.name: Odin SDK Extension
component.summary: The Odin compiler and core collections for building Flatpak applications

description.p: Builds the Odin compiler from source against the SDK's LLVM and installs it under /usr/lib/sdk/odin, together with the core, base and vendor collections and the libLLVM it was linked against. Sourcing enable.sh puts the compiler on PATH and points ODIN_ROOT at the collections.
Intended for applications written in Odin that need a compiler inside the build sandbox, where no host toolchain is reachable.
